summary: A narrowly approved V1 content replacement cannot use full-site release while unrelated legacy drafts differ or retired local IDs remain in historical snapshots. Add pinned reviewed overlays and exact-revision scoped approval without weakening full release checks.
rollback: Revert only the scoped overlay API/helper/verifier extension and guidance; ordinary full release/approval remain unchanged. A production rollback is a separately authorized deployment of the prior Worker version and does not restore database data.
